designRule: Capabilities define what a renderer must be able to do; they do not prescribe React, Vue, vanilla JS, AR, mobile, or any other implementation framework.

coreCapabilities.purpose: Render simple, contextual and transfer examples with provenance and optional progressive reveal.
Render a source/generated meaningful image, diagram, chart or visual scene with alt text and provenance metadata.
Play source audio when available and truthfully-labelled runtime TTS when used as fallback.
Render transcript/caption support without forcing it visible during retrieval tasks.
Reusable accessible drag/drop or equivalent pick-and-place interaction with keyboard/touch fallback.
Match word-image, term-definition, possessive-noun, concept-example or technical pairs.
Classify items into semantic, grammatical, technical or research categories while preserving first-attempt evidence.
Order words, sentences, derivation steps, algorithm states or workflow steps.
Use meaningful scenes/images for object identification, spatial/context comprehension and retrieval.
Capture dictation, short answers, sentence production and technical responses with preserved raw learner output.
Prompt picture-based speaking, hidden-text production, shadowing or role-play without claiming canonical pronunciation accuracy unless supported by evidence.
Display source-backed Russian stress separately from transliteration and audio support; never infer missing canonical stress.
Render line-level dialogue with role selection, audio/reveal controls and exact resume position.
Render semantic diagrams such as control block diagrams, network topologies, database relations or concept maps.
Render graphs/curves with semantic axes, units and explanation rather than decorative charts.
Host parameter exploration and simulations through adapters while keeping lesson/task identity outside the simulator implementation.
Explain what was wrong, allow correction, and distinguish hint/retry from verified completion.
Capture first attempt, correction, uncertainty, abandonment and completion evidence without silently mutating mastery.
Send only real evidence-based items to subject Review Queue/SRS policies with an exact return route.
Resume a lesson at the precise activity/item/line/step where the learner stopped.
Keep imported or transformed learning assets traceable to source locator and transformation lineage.
